# Radio-Assisted Navigation

Select routes, waypoints, motion actions, or navigation policies using wireless measurements or radio-derived spatial information to guide an agent toward a destination.

**Aliases:** wireless-assisted navigation, radio-aware navigation

**Datasets in catalogue:** 1

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
